scientific_integrity: Analytical proof is supplied. Finite independent checks are diagnostic only; external independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: The all-streak identity follows from classical Euler-number enumeration; the assessed further conclusion is strict all-depth hazard monotonicity and the non-finite-order Markov property. The model uses iid atomless priorities on the integer line, and historical-priority verification remains incomplete.
title: Infinite memory in shortest-gap streaks of the random-valley process
